Q1. Which part of this repository should be improved first?
Choices:
A. Clarification / planning workflows (`.github/workflows/*clarify*`, `*plan*`)  
B. Implementation / review automation (`implement.yml`, `review_autofix.yml`, related scripts) (RECOMMENDED)  
C. Orchestrator / validation flow (`orchestrate*`, `validate*`, related scripts)  
D. Documentation / repo guidance (`README.md`, `agents.md`, prompts/docs)  
E. Other — name the exact file(s), workflow(s), or script(s)
Q2. What kind of improvement do you want?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug or broken behavior (RECOMMENDED)  
B. Reduce flakiness / improve reliability  
C. Improve performance / reduce runtime or API usage  
D. Improve logs, alerts, or observability  
E. Clean up docs / wording / instructions
Q3. What specific problem should the change solve?
Choices:
A. A workflow/run is failing — provide the workflow name, job/step, and error text (RECOMMENDED)  
B. The workflow succeeds but behaves incorrectly — describe the wrong vs expected behavior  
C. The repo is hard to operate or understand — point to the confusing file/section  
D. I want a general improvement — describe the exact user-visible result you want
Q4. How should we judge success for this issue?
Choices:
A. A specific failing workflow/job should pass after the change (RECOMMENDED)  
B. A specific bug/incorrect behavior should stop happening  
C. A doc/prompt/output should read differently — quote the before/after expectation  
D. Another measurable outcome — describe it explicitly
